title: Rainbow Colors for Kids! Light and Dark Shades
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bloop, and welcome to Bloop's Color Lab!
Today we're exploring light colors, dark colors, and a big bright rainbow!
I put on my lab goggles, and I'm ready to learn something new with you.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Ready? Let's wiggle into the lab!

lines: Here's a clue: it's the color of clouds and snow! Can you guess?
This is White! Can you say white?
Clouds are white. Snowflakes and milk are white, too.
White is soft and bright, like fresh snow.
Can you float your arms slowly, like a soft white cloud?
Can you guess? What animal has fluffy white wool?
A sheep! And an egg is white, too.
One more time, nice and loud: WHITE! Great job!
Add white to any color, and it gets lighter.
Here's a clue: blue can be light, and blue can be dark! Can you guess?
These are Blue Shades! Light blue, and dark blue.
Look! Blue can go from light... all the way to dark.
Light blue is soft and pale. Dark blue is deep.
Can you tiptoe softly for light, and stomp for dark?
Can you guess? When is the sky light blue, and when is it dark blue?
Light blue in the daytime, and dark blue at night!
Let's say it together: BLUE SHADES!
One more time, nice and loud: BLUE SHADES! Great job!
Add white to make blue lighter. Add black to make it darker.
Bye-bye, Blue Shades! See you soon!
Here's a clue: green can be light, and green can be dark! Can you guess?
These are Green Shades! Light green, and dark green.
Look! Green goes from light, to medium, to dark.
So many greens, all in one row!
Can you stretch up tall like a big green tree?
Can you guess? What is light green, and what is dark green?
A new little leaf is light green. A pine tree is dark green!
Let's say it together: GREEN SHADES!
One more time, nice and loud: GREEN SHADES! Great job!
Look outside, and you can spot lots of different greens.
Bye-bye, Green Shades! See you soon!
Here's a clue: purple can be light, and purple can be dark! Can you guess?
These are Purple Shades! Light purple, and dark purple.
Look! Purple goes from pale lavender to deep, dark purple.
Light purple is gentle. Dark purple is rich and deep.
Can you pretend to smell a pretty purple flower? Sniff, sniff!
Can you guess? What is light purple, and what is dark purple?
Lavender flowers are light purple. Some grapes are dark purple!
Let's say it together: PURPLE SHADES!
One more time, nice and loud: PURPLE SHADES! Great job!
Light and dark colors are called shades.
Bye-bye, Purple Shades! See you soon!
Here's a clue: it's a colorful arch in the sky! Can you guess?
This is a Rainbow! Can you say rainbow?
Rainbow colors go in order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple!
Red is always on the top of the rainbow.
Can you draw a big rainbow in the air with your arm?
Can you guess? When can we see a rainbow in the sky?
When the sun shines while it rains!
One more time, nice and loud: RAINBOW! Great job!
Let's sing the order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple!

recap: And a rainbow, from red to purple!
outro: Next time it rains and the sun comes out, look for a rainbow.
Bye, friends! See you in the lab!
